sources.title: David Tong, Quantum Field Theory, complete author-hosted Cambridge lecture notes, Chapter 6
sources.locator: Complete HTML Chapter 6; read §§6.1.1, 6.2.1, 6.3.1, and 6.4, including explicit tree gauge-term equations 6.577–6.584.

contents.name: §6.1.1: local U(1) transformations of the charged field and gauge potential

source_review.read_extent: Read the complete gauge-transformation subsection and its covariance computation.
source_review.supports: The local finite U(1) phase convention and its coefficientwise inverse covariance, proved in this item.
source_review.limitations: Tong treats continuum charged fields; the item adapts the phase action to external finite graph links and makes no continuum or loop claim.

contents.name: §6.2.1: Coulomb-gauge transverse photon modes and free energy

source_review.read_extent: Read the complete transverse-mode and free-photon Hamiltonian discussion in §6.2.1.
source_review.supports: The local definition carries the transverse projection and free multiplier omega=|k| into a precise one-particle operator domain.
source_review.limitations: Tong’s continuum radiation-gauge discussion motivates the convention; the local definition proves only the finite one-particle multiplier interface and no interacting photon result.

contents.name: §6.3.1: free Dirac equation, propagator numerator and denominator

source_review.read_extent: Read the complete free-fermion subsection and the displayed propagator convention.
source_review.supports: The Dirac vertex and free propagator context for the finite rational tree identity.
source_review.limitations: Tong’s convention is translated to the local (-+++) slash and shell notation; the local proof derives the matrix inverse and does not use a boundary-value propagator.

contents.name: §6.4: explicit tree-level cancellation of longitudinal gauge terms

source_review.read_extent: Read the complete tree-scattering derivation, including equations 6.577–6.584 and the on-shell current cancellations.
source_review.supports: The current-conservation mechanism that removes a kernel term proportional to k_mu k_nu.
source_review.limitations: The local claim is limited to the displayed finite tree currents and does not assert loop or renormalization-scheme independence.

sources.title: Mark Srednicki, Quantum Field Theory, complete author-hosted 616-page book draft
sources.locator: Complete 616-page author-hosted draft; §44, printed pp. 276–281; §55, printed pp. 335–338; and §§67–68, printed pp. 400–404.

contents.name: §44: finite Grassmann coefficient integral and Gaussian determinant

source_review.read_extent: Read §44 from the definition of the Grassmann integration rule through the variable-change and complex Gaussian determinant calculations.
source_review.supports: The finite anticommuting-generator convention, top-coefficient integration, and determinant normalization.
source_review.limitations: The local item fixes its own ordered monomial and sign normalization and proves the coefficient identity over C[[z]]; no infinite-dimensional measure is inferred.

contents.name: §55: Coulomb-gauge transverse projector, free photon modes and energy multiplier

source_review.read_extent: Read the complete §55 development from the Coulomb-gauge condition and transverse projector through the free-mode expansion, polarization completeness and Hamiltonian, printed pp. 335–338.
source_review.supports: The transverse projection, massless mode frequency omega=|k|, and the omega-weighted free-photon Hamiltonian that motivate the local one-particle multiplier definition.
source_review.limitations: Srednicki uses Heaviside–Lorentz units with c=1 and continuum mode operators; the local item adopts only the transverse one-particle multiplier and its unit convention, and proves its mapping property locally.

contents.name: §67: QED Ward identities for the fermion propagator and vertex

source_review.read_extent: Read the full §67 derivation of the QED Ward identity and its propagator/vertex relation.
source_review.supports: The algebraic covariance and inverse-variation structure motivating the finite matrix identity.
source_review.limitations: Srednicki’s interacting QED relation is not used as proof of the formal finite-dimensional statement; the local coefficientwise inverse and derivative are proved from matrix multiplication.

contents.name: §68: external-photon Ward identity and polarization replacement

source_review.read_extent: Read the full §68 external-photon identity and the stated replacement of polarization by momentum.
source_review.supports: The physical motivation for longitudinal decoupling and polarization-shift invariance.
source_review.limitations: The local proof covers only the explicit finite on-shell tree currents and does not promote the source’s QED discussion to a general all-orders theorem.
